findings.label: ButtonGroup not actually reused
findings.detail: FilterGroup reimplements selection semantics in a role="group" div instead of composing the ButtonGroup molecule the spec names. Behavior is correct and Tag/ButtonGroup are not restyled; confirm the author intended convention-only reuse.

findings.label: No arrow-key navigation in FilterGroup
findings.detail: Chips are reachable by Tab and operable with Enter/Space, but there is no roving-tabindex/arrow-key movement within the group. Acceptable for a chip group; consider adding if the design calls for single-tab-stop behavior.
